text:
sam: FYI customer (acct: acme-inc) is seeing repeated timeouts on the /v1/rerank endpoint during an evening traffic bump. p95 from their side jumps from ~120ms to 2.3s and then we return 504/gateway-timeout or 502 intermittently. request_id=rcv_20260301_9f2b. They say it started after they increased candidate size to 400. Can we triage?

olivia: saw a similar blip in our metrics around 23:12 UTC. dashboards show rerank gateway p95 spike matched by a smaller increase in backend queue length. attaching top-level spans in the dashboard: https://dash.redwood/teams/support/rerank?q=rcv_20260301

ingrid-sre: initial check: gateway logs show bursts of concurrent retries. Looks like fanout + client retries = thundering retries. Also some endpoints show KV-cache miss rate rising at the same time (possible kvcache thrash). We should capture trace IDs and sample payloads.

kevin-eng: i pulled the raw logs for request_id rcv_20260301_9f2b and a few neighbors. backend service returned 5xx after waiting on redis kvcache for >200ms, then gateway gave up. stack shows queuing in rerank-worker at concurrency limit. Suspect candidate count is pushing per-request CPU & memory and causing tail latencies.

sam: customer provided example request body (redacted):
```json
{
  "query": "Find top answers",
  "candidates": ["cand1", "cand2", "cand3", ..., "cand400"],
  "features": {"user_tier":"pro"}
}
```
They also said they do naive retries on 500/504 without jitter.

maria: quick repro plan for staging: spin up the rerank loadtest job, use candidate_size=400, qps=75 for 5m, client retry policy = immediate x3. I can start the job if eng gives greenlight. repro helper: https://git.redwood/repro/rerank-loadgen

kevin-eng: repro snippet for loadgen (bash):
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 4500); do
  curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -d @payload.json &
  sleep 0.013  # ~75 qps
done
```
payload.json should contain 400 candidate ids.

ingrid-sre: mitigations to try immediately for customer:
- cap server-side candidate processing to 100 (safe short-term)
- add client retry jitter and exponential backoff (avoid sync retries)
- enable per-customer circuit-breaker to return 429 when queueing > 200ms
- route heavy requests to a lower-cost batch-optimized variant that tolerates higher tail latency
Please notify support when changes are applied so we can monitor. :thumbsup:

sam: i'll send the cap suggestion to the customer and ask them to apply retry jitter. Can we provide a staged deployment for capping?

kevin-eng: yes we can add a soft cap flag on the gateway (feature flag: rerank.max_candidates.soft=100) and roll it as a config change. I'll open a PR and tag @ingrid-sre for rollout window. Also adding a quick server-side early reject path to avoid heavy mem allocations for >200 candidates.

deploy-bot: deploy started for config change "rerank.max_candidates.soft=100" by kevin-eng, rollout env=staging, change_id=cfg_20260301_77a.

olivia: ops checklist for post-change verification:
1) watch gateway.p95 and rerank.worker.queue_length for 15m
2) confirm kvcache.miss_rate trend drops
3) sample traces to ensure no long blocking redis calls
4) ask customer to run same traffic pattern and send a couple request_ids

maria: i'll coordinate a staged repro in staging at 23:40 UTC and collect request_ids. if we get consistent repro, we can promote config to prod during low-traffic window (02:00-03:00 UTC).

ingrid-sre: diagnostic commands:
- proto trace: curl -H "x-trace-request: 1" -d @payload.json https://staging.redwood/v1/rerank
- logs: gcloud logging read "resource.labels.cluster_name=\"rerank-prod\" AND jsonPayload.request_id=\"rcv_20260301_9f2b\"" --limit 50
- kvcache stats: kubectl exec -it kvcache-0 -- redis-cli info | egrep "keyspace_hits|keyspace_misses|used_memory"
Add trace id to the ticket and we'll pull flame graphs if needed.

sam: customer updated: they applied jitter and reduced retries on their side and saw fewer 504s immediately. still want us to cap candidate list. i've sent the config change ETA.

kevin-eng: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/3421. I'll add smoke tests for max_candidates behavior and a simulated high-candidate load test. tagging @maria to validate repro job uses same payload format.

maria: will validate when PR merges. after we confirm staging looks good, i'll coordinate the prod rollout and message the customer.

olivia: long-term fixes to consider: better admission control in gateway, adaptive batching (reduce per-request parallelism for big candidate sets), and smarter kvcache prefetching for common candidate patterns. logging improvement: emit candidate_count on every rerank request for easier alerts.

sam: thanks team. adding notes to the ticket and marking as "in-progress: mitigation applied; staged repro running".

kevin-eng: if anyone needs the raw log snippets i pulled, ping me, i'll paste the sanitized ones here.
